display_name: Cigna Healthcare Provider Appeal & Dispute Process
_staleness_note: If today's date exceeds retrieved_date + staleness_flag_after_days, re-verify source_url before use in production.
_future_api_note: Schema designed to align with Da Vinci Coverage Requirements Discovery (CRD) FHIR IG shapes. When Cigna exposes FHIR appeal process endpoints under CMS-0057-F, this file should be populated from the API response rather than hand-authored.

regional_exceptions.note: California providers are subject to a separate set of policies and procedures. Verify at CignaforHCP.com before using this file for CA claims.

required_form.name: Request for Health Care Provider Payment Review
required_form.instructions: Select the appropriate appeal type checkbox before submitting. Available on CignaforHCP.com.

stages.name: Informal Resolution
stages.description: Initial contact with Cigna Customer Service. Attempt before submitting a written appeal — may resolve without formal filing.

stages.name: Internal Appeal
stages.description: Formal written appeal to Cigna National Appeals Unit (NAU). Primary recourse for provider-initiated disputes.

address.name: Cigna Healthcare Inc. National Appeals Unit

submission_channels.restriction: Coding edit disputes only. Requires authorized user account.

required_documentation: Original EOB, EOP, or information request letter
Supporting medical documentation (e.g., operative reports, medical records relevant to the denial)
Completed 'Request for Health Care Provider Payment Review' form with appeal type checkbox selected

stages.name: External Review — Independent Review Organization (IRO)
stages.description: Available for medical necessity and experimental/investigational denials. Requires patient/enrollee approval before provider can request.

stages.name: Arbitration
stages.description: Final binding dispute resolution. Only available if the provider's contract with Cigna includes an arbitration provision.

submission_channels.contact: American Health Lawyers Association ADR Service

stages.precondition: Provider agreement must include an arbitration provision

denial_type_routing._note: Determines which party (provider vs. customer/enrollee) is the primary appellant for each denial type. Providers cannot appeal customer-only denials directly.

precertification_pre_service.recommended_path: Advise patient to file customer appeal; provider may submit supporting documentation

benefit_exclusion_or_limitation.recommended_path: Advise patient to file customer appeal

carc_rarc_mapping._note: EDI 835 Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (CARC) and Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARC) that indicate appeal eligibility. Enables future automated denial_type classification from real remittance data without free-text parsing.
carc_rarc_mapping._status: stub — populate from Cigna 835 companion guide when available

examples.description: Non-covered — not deemed medically necessary by payer
Service code inconsistent with modifier, or required modifier missing
